 Advertisement Getty Images Emanuele Tramacere 41 minutes ago Last updated 16 Nov 2026, 13:20 Translated by Germany-Netherlands 0-0 LIVE: Scherhant hits the post
 Share Follow GOAL on Google Follow Germany-Netherlands live as the match brings Nations League A Group 2 to a close
 Advertisement Everything is still to play for in League A Group 2, and Germany and the Netherlands face a decisive night. Their match at Berlin's Olympiastadion could determine which two teams qualify for the quarter-finals and who might enter the relegation play-offs, depending on Greece's result.
 Germany are second, level on points with Greece but behind them on head-to-head results. Victory over the Netherlands could even take them top, provided Greece do not beat bottom side Serbia. If the teams finish level on points, the head-to-head standings would condemn Greece, who lost 7-0 to the Netherlands in the reverse fixture.
 GERMANY-NETHERLANDS: MATCH DETAILS 
Germany-Netherlands 0-0
Scorers: -
 GERMANY (4-2-3-1):  Ter Stegen, Treu, Schlotterbeck, Tah, Brown, Kimmich, Pavlović, Gruda, Wirtz, Scherhant, Havertz . 
 NETHERLANDS (4-2-3-1):  Verbruggen, J. Timber, Van de Ven, Van Hecke, Dumfries, Veerman, Reijnders, Timber, Gakpo, Malen, Summerville
Referee: Nyberg (SWE)
Booked: -
Sent off: -
 GOALS AND KEY MOMENTS 
 32' POST - Germany attack down the right again, and Gruda's cross finds Scherhant at the far post. He controls it with his first touch and shoots across goal, striking the base of the post with Verbruggen beaten.
 26' CHANCE - The Netherlands launch their first counter-attack. Gakpo drives down the left and reaches the byline inside the box, firing a driven cross towards the far post. Malen tries to get his body on it but cannot direct it towards goal.
 23 ' CHANCE Kimmich's free-kick from the right catches the entire Dutch defence out. Kai Havertz times his leap well and heads towards goal, but Verbruggen is ready and saves.
 1' Kimmich risks a yellow card straight away. Malen breaks forward and the Germany captain fouls him to stop the counter-attack. The referee threatens to show a card but keeps it in his pocket.
 0' Kick-off at Berlin's Westfalenstadion at 20:45
